rows.definition: Token count in the unscoped full-context counterfactual used as the conservation baseline.
rows.distinction: A baseline count for one evaluator receipt, not a managed runtime context, context span ledger, or context-window limit.

rows.definition: pendingadmission.ProofContext is the neutral immutable identity of the companion commit and tree, Go executable and toolchain, test environment, workspace, and verifier used to prepare one pending candidate.
rows.distinction: An exact execution-input binding carried by a pending receipt; it is not qualification evidence, a runtime request context, an agent conversation context, or permission to accept the candidate.

rows.definition: pendingadmission.Binding.ContextDigest is the canonical JSON digest of that binding's ProofContext, checked so the stored execution identity cannot drift independently of the exact candidate binding.
rows.distinction: A derived integrity field for ProofContext; it is not a free-form context identifier, a digest of candidate source, qualification evidence, or an acceptance verdict.

rows.definition: The internal/ggufload WeightSource method that runs the production hierarchical, cancellable quantized tensor load: an outer tensor fan-out with a per-tensor inner worker budget, applying each computed tensor serially under the caller's context.
rows.distinction: Names the ctx-aware parallel load scheduler, not the expert-parallel memory plan or the host-load-peak admission estimate that decides whether a load may start.

rows.definition: The internal/ggufload WeightSource entry point that builds a Q4_K quantized model from a GGUF under a caller context, a load profile, and functional load options such as streamed experts; the context-aware form the plain QuantModelQ4K wrappers delegate to.
rows.distinction: Names the cancellable, option-carrying Q4_K model constructor, not the parallel tensor scheduler it drives or the generic command context.

rows.definition: nativeStructuredConstraintFromContext retrieves the request-local native JSON-schema decoder constraint stored in a Go context.Context so reused and direct decode paths apply the same token mask.
rows.distinction: It reads structured-decoding state carried through a Go context.Context; it does not manage model-visible context bytes, deadlines, or subprocess cancellation like generic context.Context plumbing.

rows.definition: Inkling2ResidentCtxEnv names FAK_INKLING2_CTX, the environment knob that sets the global-slot KV capacity of a resident Inkling-2 device session, refused, not clamped, when the device-memory KV fit (or the 32768 Metal hard bound) does not admit it, and floored at 512.
rows.distinction: The requested token capacity of one resident Inkling-2 session before it exists - not context-window (the model's fixed trained limit) and not FixedContextTokens (macfit's per-model planning constant); admission prices this value against device memory.

rows.definition: Inkling2ResidentCtxMax(backend) is the largest global-slot KV context a resident Inkling-2 device session takes on the named backend: 32768 on Metal, 24576 on every other backend (the CUDA bound).
rows.distinction: The backend's hard ceiling that FAK_INKLING2_CTX is clamped to and fak serve refuses past - not Inkling2ResidentCtxEnv (the requested capacity knob), not context-window (the model's trained limit), and not FixedContextTokens (macfit's planning constant).

rows.definition: Inkling2AutoCtxCeiling is the default 16384-token auto-context ceiling for resident Inkling-2 device sessions when FAK_INKLING2_CTX is unset, shared by CUDA and Metal admission.
rows.distinction: The default auto-sized context cap for 16 GiB devices - not Inkling2ResidentCtxMax (the explicit backend hard ceiling) and not Inkling2ResidentFitCtx (the live free-memory fit calculation).

rows.definition: Inkling2ResidentCtxPin fixes the global KV cache context of the next resident Inkling-2 session to a caller-admitted token count instead of re-deriving it from free memory.
rows.distinction: The process-level context pin set by fak serve for already-admitted sessions - not Inkling2ResidentCtxEnv (the FAK_INKLING2_CTX env var) and not Inkling2AutoCtxCeiling (the default auto-fit ceiling).

rows.definition: Inkling2ResidentFitCtx computes the largest resident Inkling-2 global context that fits in a given free-memory byte count after device headroom reserve, in 256-token steps.
rows.distinction: The pure free-VRAM-to-context fit calculator - not Inkling2AutoCtxCeiling (the default ceiling applied to auto-fit) and not Inkling2ResidentCtxMax (the backend hard bound).

rows.definition: MaxResidentCtx is the hard upper-bound resident global KV context on ModelMemoryBudget consumed by the model-agnostic ServeEnvelope solver, clamping resolved context tokens below backend capacity limits.
rows.distinction: The model-agnostic backend hard resident context ceiling in ModelMemoryBudget - not Inkling2AutoCtxCeiling (the default auto-fit cap) and not Inkling2ResidentFitCtx (the live free-VRAM fit calculation).
